notes: 1. HV Code = a Channel Partner's unique HoABL Venture code (e.g., HV00026097). Master HV Code = the HV Code of the Master CP a Member CP is mapped under.

2. CP = Channel Partner (a licensed broker/agent). Master CP = a senior CP who can have Member CPs mapped beneath them; Member CP = the default type on registration. Only Master CPs appear in the Map-to-Master dropdown.
3. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] = a disposable UAT CP record (a Member CP that can safely be mapped or marked as Master) must be supplied before executing this destructive/state-changing test.
4. [VERIFY WITH DEV] = behaviour not confirmed by visual-memory screenshots and/or BRD/FRD/FS; confirm before treating Pass/Fail as authoritative.

5. The header count is a LIVE total of all CPs in the system and does NOT change when search or column filters are applied. BRD/FRD/FS text says '2705 Channel Partners' but the live page (visual-memory, captured 2026-06-03) shows '2709 Channel Partners' — read the current number, do NOT assert the literal 2705 (see DOC_DRIFT-CP-001).

6. The header action button is labelled 'Map to Master' in the live UI (visual-memory), not 'Map Master CP' as written in BRD/FRD; it is disabled until at least one row checkbox is ticked. The mapping modal title is 'Map CPs to Master' and its confirm button is 'Map to Master' (see DOC_DRIFT-CP-002).

7. The row Actions cell confirmed in visual-memory contains only a single eye icon (View CP detail). The three-dot (…) menu and the 'Mark as Master' option described in BRD/FRD/FS are NOT visible in the captured screenshots — all three-dot / Mark-as-Master cases are flagged [VERIFY WITH DEV] until the live control is confirmed (see DOC_DRIFT-CP-003).

8. The CP Detail drawer (title 'Channel Partner Details' per FRD/FS) is NOT captured in visual-memory — all drawer-internal field/section cases are flagged [VERIFY WITH DEV] because the rendered drawer state is unconfirmed (see DOC_DRIFT-CP-004).

9. CP KYC Status (Pending / Approved / Rejected / Verified) is the CP's own KYC from the CP Portal — NOT the Admin Customers KYC flow. On UAT all test CPs are 'Pending' by default; the KYC approval flow is not exercised here.
10. SM Name / SM Email ID / SM Mobile Number columns are auto-populated from the Sales Manager assigned to the CP (via the Sales Managers module). They show '-' when no SM is linked.

11. No CP notification (SMS / WhatsApp / email) is dispatched for any admin action in this module — Mark-as-Master, Map-to-Master and Bulk-Map are all silent by design (FS §8). Verify the DB/audit side-effect, never flag the absence of a toast/SMS as a defect.

12. There is NO admin-side CP create / approve / reject / activate / deactivate / delete — confirmed against the admin-cp route set (list / get / mark-master / map-master / bulk-map-excel only). Any BRD claim of CP CRUD from admin is invalid.
13. Destructive / state-changing tests (Mark as Master, Map to Master, Bulk Map) require user authorisation before running on UAT — they mutate stateful CP records.

tcs.description: Verify that selecting a Master and confirming maps the selected CPs and updates the Master HV Code column.
tcs.precond: Two disposable Member CPs are selected; user has authorised the state change on UAT.
tcs.steps:
1. With two Member CP rows selected, click Map to Master.
2. Select a Master HV Code in the modal.
3. Click the 'Map to Master' confirm button.
4. Observe the table.
tcs.testData: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] two disposable Member CPs + one valid Master HV Code
tcs.expected: The modal closes and the Master HV Code column updates for the two mapped rows to the chosen master. [VERIFY WITH DEV] whether a success toast appears — backend update is the authoritative side-effect (silent action per FS §8).
tcs.evidence: channel-partners-map-modal.png + FS Feature 6 §6/§7 (map-master)

tcs.scenario: To verify Cancel closes the modal without mapping
tcs.description: Verify that clicking Cancel in the mapping modal closes it without changing any mapping.
tcs.precond: The mapping modal is open with rows selected.
tcs.steps:
1. Click the Cancel button in the modal.
2. Observe the table.
tcs.expected: The modal closes and no Master HV Code values change for the selected rows.
tcs.evidence: channel-partners-map-modal.png (Cancel button) + FS Feature 6 §5

tcs.scenario: To verify remapping an already-mapped CP replaces the master
tcs.description: Verify that mapping a CP that is already under Master A to Master B replaces the existing relationship.
tcs.precond: A disposable Member CP already mapped to Master A; user has authorised the change.
tcs.steps:
1. Select the CP currently mapped to Master A.
2. Map it to Master B and confirm.
3. Read the Master HV Code column for that row.
tcs.testData: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a Member CP mapped to Master A + a second Master B
tcs.expected: The Master HV Code updates from Master A to Master B — the previous mapping is replaced (a CP has only one Master at a time, FS Feature 6 §6 rule 4).
tcs.evidence: FS Feature 6 §6 rule 4 (one master at a time, remap replaces)

tcs.scenario: To verify mapping a Master under another Master is rejected
tcs.description: Verify that attempting to map a Master CP under another Master CP is rejected by the backend.
tcs.precond: Two Master CPs (Master A and Master B) exist; user has authorised the attempt.
tcs.steps:
1. Select Master B's row.
2. Click Map to Master.
3. Choose Master A in the dropdown.
4. Click the confirm button.
tcs.expected: [VERIFY WITH DEV] The mapping is rejected (a Master cannot be mapped under another Master) and Master B remains a Master CP. The exact UI/HTTP behaviour is not documented in FS — confirm with dev.
tcs.evidence: FRD §10 mark-master/map-master logic (rejection behaviour not explicitly specified)

tcs.scenario: To verify Bulk Map via Excel upload

tcs.testData: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] an XLSX with columns Member HV Code, Master HV Code (5 valid pairings)

tcs.evidence: FRD §10 API (bulk-map-excel, field 'doc') — UI control not captured in visual-memory

tcs.scenario: To verify Bulk Map rejects an invalid file type

tcs.scenario: To verify unauthenticated access is blocked
tcs.description: Verify that hitting /admin/channel-partners with no admin session redirects to login.

tcs.steps:

tcs.expected: The browser is redirected to the Admin login page; the CP list is not shown.

tcs.scenario: To verify an expired/invalid token is rejected on the CP list API
tcs.description: Verify the CP list API rejects an invalid or expired bearer token.
tcs.precond: An invalid/expired bearer token is available.
tcs.steps:
1. Call GET /api/v1/admin/cp with an invalid/expired token.
2. Observe the HTTP status.
tcs.expected: The API responds 401 Unauthorized (or 403 Forbidden) and returns no CP data.
tcs.evidence: FRD §10 API GET /cp + dimensions §9 auth

tcs.scenario: To verify the CP list API is more permissive than the UI search
tcs.description: Verify the backend CP list API accepts query params the UI does not surface as controls (UI-vs-backend split).
tcs.precond: A valid admin bearer token is available.
tcs.steps:
1. Call GET /api/v1/admin/cp with cpType, masterHvCode and businessRegion query params directly.
2. Observe the filtered result.
tcs.expected: [VERIFY WITH DEV] The API filters by the supplied params even where no UI control exists. Confirm whether the API enforces the same constraints as the UI.
tcs.evidence: FRD §10 API query params + dimensions §8 UI-vs-backend

tcs.scenario: To verify SM Admin is denied on CP admin endpoints
tcs.description: Verify that a Sales Manager Admin role is forbidden from the admin CP endpoints (only the admin role is allowed).
tcs.precond: A valid SM Admin bearer token is available.
tcs.steps:
1. Call GET /api/v1/admin/cp with an SM Admin token.
2. Observe the HTTP status.
tcs.testData: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a valid SM Admin bearer token
tcs.expected: [VERIFY WITH DEV] HTTP 403 Forbidden — only the admin role is permitted on admin CP endpoints. Note BRD §2 lists 'Sales Manager Admin' as a user of this screen, which conflicts with a 403 — confirm the authoritative role rule with dev.
tcs.evidence: FSD-CORRECTION (prior workbook ADM_CP_FSD_045) vs BRD §2 (SM Admin listed as user) — conflict, verify

tcs.scenario: To verify Map to Master dispatches NO notification
tcs.description: Verify that mapping CPs to a Master sends no SMS / WhatsApp / email — the action is silent.
tcs.precond: A Map-to-Master action has just been performed on disposable CPs.
tcs.steps:
1. Map disposable Member CPs to a Master.
2. Inspect the messaging/email dispatch logs and the CP phones.
tcs.expected: No SMS, WhatsApp or email is dispatched to any mapped CP. Only the DB update (masterHvCode) and the audit-log entry occur (FS Feature 6 §8/§9). Silence is by design.
tcs.evidence: FS Feature 6 §8 Notifications None / §9 Audit
